content: eBay and three former executives will pay $55.7 million as part of a settlement with a Massachusetts couple targeted with a bizarre harassment and cyberstalking campaign in 2019, as reported earlier by CNBC. The settlement will resolve a lengthy legal saga that revealed how eBay’s former executives sent live insects, a bloody pig mask, a funeral wreath, and other strange items to David and Ina Steiner over their newsletter’s coverage of eBay. The Steiners, who operate the EcommerceBytes newsletter, sued eBay and its former executives — including ex-CEO Devin Wenig —  in 2021. The lawsuit accused the company and its executives of launching a coordinated effort to “intimidate, threaten to kill, torture, terrorize, stalk and silence” the Steiners in an attempt to “stifle” their eBay-related reporting. The Department of Justice charged seven former eBay employees in connection with the harassment campaign in 2020, all of whom have been convicted. eBay agreed to pay a $3 million criminal penalty related to the case in 2024. Wenig wasn’t charged and says that he had no knowledge of the harassment. “As we have long stated, what the Steiners were subjected to by former eBay employees in 2019 was wrong, reprehensible and should never have happened,” eBay says in a statement on its website. “We condemn, in the strongest terms possible, the employees who perpetrated and pled guilty to criminal charges for the misconduct against Ina and David Steiner.” The $55.7 million settlement will include $46.15 million from eBay, $2 million from Wenig, $500,000 from former global operations SVP Wendy Jones, and $50,000 from former chief communications officer Steve Wymer. eBay will also donate $6 million to nonprofit organizations.

chineseContent: 据 CNBC 早些时候报道，eBay 和三名前高管将支付 5570 万美元，作为与一对马萨诸塞州夫妇达成和解的一部分，这对夫妇在 2019 年遭受了离奇的骚扰和网络跟踪活动。该和解协议将解决一场冗长的法律纠纷，该纠纷揭露了 eBay 前高管如何因 David 和 Ina Steiner 时事通讯对 eBay 的报道，向他们寄送活昆虫、血腥猪面具、葬礼花圈和其他奇怪物品。运营 EcommerceBytes 时事通讯的斯坦纳夫妇于 2021 年起诉 eBay 及其前高管（包括前首席执行官德文·维尼格）。诉讼指控该公司及其高管协调一致，“恐吓、威胁杀死、折磨、恐吓、跟踪和压制”斯坦纳夫妇，试图“扼杀”他们与 eBay 相关的报道。美国司法部指控 7 名 eBay 前员工涉嫌 2020 年的骚扰活动，所有这些人均已被定罪。 eBay 同意在 2024 年支付与此案相关的 300 万美元刑事处罚。韦尼格没有受到指控，并表示他对骚扰事件一无所知。 eBay 在其网站上的一份声明中表示：“正如我们长期以来所说，2019 年 eBay 前员工所遭受的施泰纳兄弟的行为是错误的，应受到谴责，而且根本不应该发生。” “我们以最强烈的措辞谴责那些对艾娜和大卫斯坦纳实施不当行为并承认刑事指控的员工。” 5570 万美元的和解金将包括 eBay 的 4615 万美元、Wenig 的 200 万美元、前全球运营高级副总裁 Wendy Jones 的 50 万美元以及前首席通讯官 Steve Wymer 的 5 万美元。 eBay 还将向非营利组织捐赠 600 万美元。
